notes.title: An update from Colorway Antics!
notes.content: [h2][b]🎨 Hey artists — we’re back![/b][/h2][p]It’s been a while since our last update, but we’ve been quietly working behind the scenes to make Colorway Antics more accessible and even more fun for everyone.[/p][p]We’re excited to announce that [b]Spanish and Chinese localisations[/b] are coming soon! 🥳 [/p][p]But that's not all - stay tuned for the next update to see what other [i]antics[/i] we've been up to![/p]

notes.title: Nominate Colorway Antics for the Steam Awards!
notes.content:
[h1]Give us the best Christmas gift ever by nominating Colorway Antics for the Sit Back and Relax category![/h1]

Releasing Colorway Antics this year has been a major achievement for us here at Mīharo Innovations. Each review, stream, and shared scene gets us excited every time. It's that time of the year again when many great games are recognised on Steam, and it would be a huge deal be a part of it. [b]Give us the best Christmas gift ever by nominating Colorway Antics for the Sit Back and Relax category![/b]

If you haven't tried Colorway Antics yet- now is the perfect time! We will be a part of the Autumn Sale so you can get painting and relaxing at a low price. With various painting tools, the possibilities are endless for what masterpieces you get to create! An abstract paint splashed wall perhaps? Fully hand-painted floor mosaic? Or maybe just sit back and relax and watch the paint balloons go by in space with anti-gravity, now that's a perfect way to end a busy day. [i]Worthy of an award nomination I'd say...[/i]

notes.title: Boom! Update 1.1 is here!
notes.content:
Update 1.1 is here! We’re excited to share with the community Colorway Antics first update. If you enjoy the update, please, leave us a review. Your feedback is valuable.

[previewyoutube=v9qi-1I1MpI;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]What’s new:[/b]
[list]
[*] 2 new, color-based, mini-games, playable in all painting scenes
[list]
[*] Splash & Splatter - beat the AI PaintBot in a race against time to throw the most paint in a scene with paintballs
[*] Color Codebreaker- memorise the color pattern and defuse as many bombs as possible before time runs out [/list]
[*] Ability to export your artwork as a 360 image and share via [url=https://colorway-antics.com/share]colorway-antics.com/share[/url]
[*] Lots of new stickers added
[*] Updated models for painting tool(s)
[*] New slider for changing tool sizes
[*] Ability to change graphical resolution settings to provide improved support for devices
[*] Ability to turn off background music
[*] Misc. new/improved animations
[/list]
[b]Minor changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Sticker projections: Project your stickers onto surfaces for better accuracy
[*] Selection of models animate in scene
[/list]
[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] SFX level fixed in scenes
[/list]
Looking ahead, we already have a mountain of ideas for ‘Update 1.2’. However, before we lock them in, reach out and let us know what you’d like to see in included within Colorway Antics. Who knows, it might make the features list. Until then, stay creative.

notes.title: What's in for Update 1.1
notes.content:
We’re inching closer to releasing  ‘Update 1.1’; and super excited to add some new colorful dimensions to the main game. Definitely looking forward to seeing what the community does with it.

Last announcement, I mentioned Update 1.1 was bringing two color-based mini games. Check them out (below) and let me know your thoughts.

[h3]–	Splash & Splatter[/h3]
Welcome to the fast-paced Splash & Splatter! Engage in a thrilling territorial battle against a formidable drone as you vie to apply the most paint within the ticking clock. Armed with paintballs, unleash your artistic prowess and outmanoeuvre the drone to claim victory in this high-stakes challenge of colorful conquest. Who will emerge as the reigning master of the paint-splattered domain? Get ready to make a splash!

[h3]–	Color Codebreaker[/h3]
Welcome to the mind-bending Color Codebreaker! Test your memory prowess in this high-stakes challenge of deciphering color-based sequences to disarm bombs. Race against time as you push your memory to the limits, defusing as many bombs as possible. Beware the consequences of mistakes – a misstep leaves you drenched in vibrant paint. Sharpen your memory skills and embrace the adrenaline as you unravel the colorful codes!

Meanwhile, we've just released our update 1.03 with smooth turning and a music toggle for those who prefer to listen to their own tunes.

notes.title: Update 1.1 for Colorway Antics Coming Soon!
notes.content:
[h3][b]Exciting news! 'Update 1.1' for Colorway Antics is just around the corner, packed with thrilling additions for our amazing community.[/b][/h3]

In this update: Brace yourself for not one, but two vibrant color-based mini games, taking your artistic journey to new heights. Experience enhanced painting tools, making your creative process even smoother. Share your masterpieces effortlessly with our new share mechanic. Plus, we've incorporated valuable community feedback to bring you several quality of life improvements.

Get ready to indulge in the ultimate painting adventure. Don't forget to wishlist and spread the word to your friends. Let the colors ignite your imagination!

notes.title: Share your thoughts and shape our next update.
notes.content:
[h3][b]Hey painters![/b][/h3]

What antics have you been up to in Colorway Antics?

Are you ready for more colorful escapades? We're working on exciting new updates, but we need your help first.

What do you think of Colorway Antics so far? What have been your favorite moments, scenes, canvas? And most importantly, what can we do to make the game even more fun for you?

Your feedback and reviews are crucial in helping us improve our game and make it the best it can be. Let us know your thoughts in the reviews!
